146	## Orchestration (agreed with Pavol, 2026-08-23)

148	Coordinator/worker split, so the coordinating session's context survives the

150	
151	- **Coordinator** (the main session) never runs a build or reads a log dump.
152	  It sequences workers, launches them with a brief, and between workers runs

155	  tick present. Deviations land with the coordinator; anything in "Known

    Pin javac target=1.8 across build.xml (JDK 11 fix)
    
    Under JDK 11, ant's javac tasks — which set source= but never target=
    (three set neither) — defaulted target to 11. The resulting v55

    compiler-suite tests failed (testSystem was unaffected: the interpreter
    never parses classfiles). Pinning target=${javaSourceVersion} on all
    8 javac tasks restores v52 output (verified with javap and an ASM 3.1
    probe). Original-tree edit: build.xml only.

by default) and defuses that landmine before the ladder climbs.
